# More on Keywords

[Short page just re-iterating concept of keyword, emphasizing bigger than import statements]

```{python}
import numpy as np
```

```{python}
"e" in "Peter"
```

```{python}
"z" in "Peter"
```

```{python}
1 in [1, 2, 3]
```

```{python}
(10 > 8) and (9 < 11)
```

```{python}
(10 > 8) and (9 < 8)
```

```{python}
(10 > 8) or (9 < 11)
```
